hypothesis: RL step 9 or V5 can extract useful, source-grounded paper evidence cards for the research MCP
expected_signal: At least 2 of 3 cards per arm have valid schema, exact quotation, and reviewed claim support; neither comparator paper falsely claims a direct domain-mixing experiment
decision_rule: Use as draft-only reader only if an arm passes all three cases on schema and quote, at least 2 of 3 on claim-level support, and correctly marks both DCLM and FineWeb as non-direct comparisons. Otherwise keep Qwen outside the evidence-card loop.
question: What evidence supports adding domain mixing to quality-filtered web data for language-model pretraining?
note: A tiny development probe, not held-out model validation or proof of model improvement.
